name: ToolRail
description:
One single-choice toolbar; large kits group by public tool family. A tool marked `standalone`
keeps its own button after its family's flyout.
signature: ({ tools, editor, toolLabels, onToolSelect, reset }: ToolRailProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: onToolSelect
props.description: Optional shared command runner; otherwise selection uses the session action.

props.name: reset
props.description: Show a Reset button at the end that removes the chosen tool's edits as one undo step. Default true.

props.name: toolLabels
props.description: Resolved labels, for sharing with a host's action set.
